text:
maya: quick heads-up — master CI is red on a subset of GPU runners, seeing JIT/PTX load failures and a couple of illegal memory access OOMs. started on the new runtime build after the toolchain bump.

maya: error snippet from the runner:
```
E backend/runtime/cuda_module_loader.cc:123] cuModuleLoadDataEx failed: JIT compilation failed:
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unsupported PTX version '7.8' for device-specific compilation
...
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what(): cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
```

sri: which job id / runner label? is this only on certain nodes or all GPUs?

maya: job gpu-e2e/1023 on runner label `dgx-rt-prod-3` (A100-80GB). link: https://ci.internal/reports/1023 (CI artifact has full log). failing on 3/6 GPU runners.

ci-bot: rerun requested by @maya — queued on available runner with same labels.

alex: looks like a PTX/driver mismatch rather than a pure memory bug. recent container image upgraded nvcc/toolchain to emit PTX 7.8; some nodes still have driver 510.* which rejects the PTX JIT. can you dump the driver on that runner? `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader`

maya: ran the check on dgx-rt-prod-3: output is `510.85.02` for two nodes, but the failing one reported `525.60.13` earlier. so mixed fleet.

alex: that mix explains why only 3/6 runners fail. options: rebuild the image to target an older PTX (emit cubin for sm_80) or upgrade drivers on the old hosts.

sri: short-term: can we bisect whether it's a container/toolchain change? @ops-bot can you run the same job with the previous image tag (sha abc123) on the exact failing host? we need a clean compare.

ops-bot: queued rerun on dgx-rt-prod-3 using image sha:abc123 — started.

ops-bot: rerun finished (sha:abc123) — job PASSED on that host.

maya: good signal. so regression introduced in image build (nvcc flags/toolkit) not the infra driver.

alex: action items: 1) revert runtime/toolchain bump in the image for the short term, 2) add a tiny CI sanity test that jit-loads a minimal PTX/cubin on each GPU runner at startup, 3) plan controlled driver upgrades for fleet.

maya: i'll open a rollback PR for the image and add the PTX smoke test to the image repo. pinging @alex @sri for review.

ci-bot: build + test artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1023/logs + https://ci.internal/artifacts/1023/cuda_jit_dump.txt

alex: also add a note in the release checklist: "verify driver compatibility matrix (nvcc vs driver) — test ticket included".

maya: thanks all — rolling rollback PR up now. marking this thread resolved after PR lands. :thumbsup:
